lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Right. If it is paying somebody, there is an instrument that says it has to. Nothing in this system moves without one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Steward's governing charter opens. It is not a statute — there is no enacting formula, no sponsoring department, no commencement date.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It has parties. It has a term. It has a schedule of consideration. Those are the things a contract has.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The Steward is not a public body operating under law. It is a private instrument operating under an agreement, and the difference is the whole of my century.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: And there is a beneficiary clause, and the record cannot resolve who it names. Not will not — cannot. The name has never been indexed, because in two hundred and eighty-one years nobody has asked it to be.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Somewhere below this floor, a fan changes pitch. Your session ends without a prompt.
